NB_noise_area_breakout.paths: 4 x 600 sessions, minute bars from 5-second random walks

D7_family_as_coded.note: geometric random walk, trades open at the end dropped (as family_d7.py), 40-60 paths

reading: No look-ahead in either. The D7 'as coded' figures are positive because a geometric walk drifts up in arithmetic terms (sigma^2/2 a period, real for any long book) and because trades still open at the end of a window are dropped; with an arithmetic martingale and open trades marked they go to about zero.
